body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> JVC 'GS-TD1', camcorder with twin lens at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
Full HD 3D recording of 1902x1080 resolution is available at 'GS-TD1' and when 3D recording, 5X optical zoom is supported.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
